title: Precise, Fast, and Low-cost Concept Erasure in Value Space: Orthogonal Complement Matters
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical method (AdaVD) for concept erasure in text-to-image diffusion models. While it evaluates the method's ability to erase 'offensive' or 'unsafe' (NSFW) content using standard safety benchmarks like I2P, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, specific moral frameworks, or ethical systems.
